- Follow-up to the `additional_plots_meeting_20261013` lab book's task 4 (% of EGFP+ cells in the final full object), which only reported the by-cell-type and by-sample percentages separately, pooled across the other dimension. This recomputes the same `EGFP_positive` metadata (exact `14.1` matching logic) on the full merged object and also produces the cell type x sample cross-tab, which was never actually computed.
- All five cell types, all four samples, cell-cycle genes retained (`06-cluster_marker_genes/final_interesting_cells_0.6.rds` - same object task 4 used).

# Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(Seurat)
```

# Set project directories

```{r}
project_repo_dir <- "/home/melanie-smith/workDir/sophieWiszniak/20251104_sophieWiszniak_ncc_pa"
out_dir <- file.path(project_repo_dir, "outDir", "14-rna_velocity")
downloads_dir <- file.path(project_repo_dir, "downloads")

full_object_path <- file.path(project_repo_dir, "outDir", "06-cluster_marker_genes", "final_interesting_cells_0.6.rds")
```

# Load the full merged Seurat object

```{r}
full_object <- read_rds(full_object_path)

stopifnot(inherits(full_object, "Seurat"))

message("Dimensions of full merged object: ", paste(dim(full_object), collapse = " x "))
print(table(full_object$orig.ident))
```

# Add EGFP transgene metadata
- Exact matching logic as `14.1`: per-sample barcode-suffix match against the re-quantified transgene TSVs, `EGFP` rows only, single-UMI detections zeroed as leaky signal, `EGFP_positive <- EGFP_UMI > 0`.

```{r add-egfp-metadata}
sample_suffixes <- c(
  e11_control = "_1_1",
  e11_ko      = "_2_1",
  e12_control = "_1",
  e12_ko      = "_2"
)

egfp_umi <- setNames(rep(0L, ncol(full_object)), colnames(full_object))

for (sample_ID in names(sample_suffixes)) {

  tsv_path <- file.path(downloads_dir, paste0(sample_ID, "_transgene_umis_final.tsv"))

  tsv <- read.delim(tsv_path, header = FALSE,
                     col.names = c("barcode", "gene", "umi"))

  egfp_rows <- tsv[tsv$gene == "EGFP", ]

  full_barcodes <- paste0(egfp_rows$barcode, sample_suffixes[[sample_ID]])

  matched <- full_barcodes %in% names(egfp_umi)

  message(
    sample_ID, " - EGFP rows: ", nrow(egfp_rows),
    " | matched to object: ", sum(matched),
    " (", round(100 * mean(matched), 1), "%)"
  )

  egfp_umi[full_barcodes[matched]] <- egfp_rows$umi[matched]
}

n_leaky <- sum(egfp_umi == 1)
message(n_leaky, " cells with exactly 1 EGFP UMI zeroed out as leaky signal")
egfp_umi[egfp_umi < 2] <- 0

full_object <- AddMetaData(full_object, metadata = egfp_umi, col.name = "EGFP_UMI")
full_object$EGFP_positive <- full_object$EGFP_UMI > 0

message("Total EGFP-positive cells: ", sum(full_object$EGFP_positive), " of ", ncol(full_object))
```

# % EGFP+ by cell type (pooled across samples)
- Sanity check against task 4's already-reported numbers (Mesenchyme 5.25%, VSMC 0.70%, Endocardium 0.10%, Epicardium 0.10%, Myocardium 0.07%).

```{r pct-by-celltype}
pct_by_celltype <- full_object@meta.data %>%
  group_by(new_celltypes) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(),
            n_egfp_positive = sum(EGFP_positive),
            pct_egfp_positive = round(100 * n_egfp_positive / n_cells, 2)) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_egfp_positive))

print(pct_by_celltype)

write.csv(pct_by_celltype,
          file.path(out_dir, "egfp_pct_positive_by_celltype_full_object.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# % EGFP+ by cell type x sample (orig.ident)
- Not computed anywhere else in this project - task 4 only reported pooled-by-sample (not split by cell type) and pooled-by-cell-type (not split by sample) percentages separately.

```{r pct-by-celltype-sample}
pct_by_celltype_sample <- full_object@meta.data %>%
  group_by(new_celltypes, orig.ident) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(),
            n_egfp_positive = sum(EGFP_positive),
            pct_egfp_positive = round(100 * n_egfp_positive / n_cells, 2)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(new_celltypes, orig.ident)

print(pct_by_celltype_sample)

write.csv(pct_by_celltype_sample,
          file.path(out_dir, "egfp_pct_positive_by_celltype_sample_full_object.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# wide version (cell type x sample), easier to drop straight into the lab book as one table
pct_wide <- pct_by_celltype_sample %>%
  select(new_celltypes, orig.ident, pct_egfp_positive) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = orig.ident, values_from = pct_egfp_positive)

print(pct_wide)

write.csv(pct_wide,
          file.path(out_dir, "egfp_pct_positive_by_celltype_sample_full_object_wide.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
